title: Reranker quantization profiles + ranking-quality evaluation (NDCG / MRR)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Objective: Produce a set of tested quantization profiles (FP8 and INT8 variants) for the reranker model family used in ranking pipelines, define a reproducible calibration workflow, and validate ranking quality using NDCG and MRR thresholds. Goals are: 1) identify quant profiles that provide >3x inference throughput or >=2x token-tps per GPU vs baseline fp16 while keeping relative ranking quality drop <= 0.5 NDCG points (NDCG@3) and insignificant change in MRR; 2) produce calibration artifacts and scripts that can be run in CI; 3) integrate profile metadata into model catalog and runtime fallback rules.
acceptance_criteria: Set of candidate quant profiles (names, tensor types, per-channel vs per-tensor) for each reranker variant checked into repo
Calibration pipeline (data selection, per-layer range estimation, exporter) documented and runnable via pipeline script
Evaluation harness computes NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR, with baseline (fp16) vs each quantized variant and outputs significance tests
Automated gating rule: any candidate with NDCG@3 drop > 0.5 or MRR drop > 0.01 is rejected; results surfaced in perf dashboard
Profiles added to model catalog with required compat metadata (kernel hints, sequence-length constraints, preferred kernel)

experiment_plan: 1) Define candidate profiles: FP8-E4M3 emulation, INT8 symmetric per-channel, INT8 asymmetric per-tensor, mixed precision (INT8 weights + FP8 activations). 2) Implement calibration ops: MinMax, KL, 99.9 percentile, MSE per-layer. 3) Run calibration on 3 datasets: small (5k), medium (50k), extended (200k) sampled from production query logs with stratified query length. 4) Quantize and generate model artifacts; run offline eval harness computing NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR, plus paired t-test and bootstrap CI. 5) Benchmark throughput/latency on target runtime configs (A100/RTX6000/Inferentia placeholder) and capture memory/KV cache effects. 6) Gate and document profiles for catalog and runtime fallback rules.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: calibration under-estimates rare activation peaks causing rank degradation in tail queries. Mitigation: include tail-sampled queries in calibration set and use per-channel symmetric scaling for attention layers. Risk: FP8 variance between hardware implementations. Mitigation: mark FP8 profiles as hardware-sensitive and require nightly regression checks.
notes_for_engineering:
